name: reboards
title: ReBoards
description: Revamped agile boards: work with relations, group subtasks under their parent, use multiple swimlane levels and plan in time.
changeNotes:
Version 1.2.0:
- Add subtask navigation mode: P or Shift+P starts it, and the arrow keys move to the parent, subtasks and sibling subtasks.
- Add swimlane navigation mode: S or Shift+S jumps to the next or previous swimlane, and up/down keep going.
- Add highlight navigation mode: choosing a highlight selects the first match, and up/down step through the rest.
- Various layout fixes.

widgets.name: ReBoards
